wire.t: Pittsburgh benched Aaron Rodgers late Tuesday night and will start Mason Rudolph Friday against Denver, with Rodgers inactive. The team says it isn't injury-related. Rodgers was on the Hold My DK bench, and at 6:10 AM ET Wednesday TheMoneyTeam2302 added Rudolph and dropped Tanner McKee.

Josh Jacobs (finger surgery) was ruled out for tonight's Packers-Rams game, his second straight absence, and Kaleb Johnson is the reported lead back. Jacobs sits in the IR slot of The Champ. Kaleb Johnson sits on the taxi squad of StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, where he can't help anybody.

Kenneth Walker III (groin) practiced on a limited basis Tuesday and is trending toward playing at Buffalo on Thanksgiving after missing two games. He's already in the Catfan94’s Farm Team lineup. Emmett Johnson, who was Kansas City's lead back while Walker was out, is on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench.

Denver suspended J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team, and Jonah Coleman is expected to start Sunday. Both belong to Kraft for Cash. Coleman scored 35.4 in Week 11 and is already in the lineup.

Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol, and Jim Harbaugh said there's "a lot left to be determined" this week. DJ Uiagalelei is next man up. Kraft for Cash has Herbert and Bryce Young starting with Anthony Richardson Sr. on the bench.

New England named Tommy DeVito its Week 12 starter with Drake Maye out at least six weeks. DeVito is a free agent in this league. Daniel Jones went unclaimed on NFL waivers and is still unsigned, and he's in the Asian Jim starting lineup at quarterback as of Wednesday morning.

Saquon Barkley (stinger) practiced in full Tuesday and is expected to play in Dallas on Thanksgiving, good news for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. Joe Milton III has started Philadelphia's last two games with Jalen Hurts on IR; Milton is on the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench. Jake Ferguson hasn't practiced for Dallas.

League moves: Rudolph-for-McKee is the only Week 12 transaction. Washington activated Jacory Croskey-Merritt from IR on Monday the 23rd, and Bill_Buttlicker still has him in an IR slot. Brandon Aiyuk visits Washington on Wednesday; he's on the I Chase Brown Kids bench.

stories.title: Pittsburgh benches Aaron Rodgers late Tuesday night, and TheMoneyTeam2302 has Mason Rudolph by 6:10 AM
stories.dek: Hold My DK is 10‑1 and still treats the waiver wire like a contender. Tanner McKee is the casualty.
body: Late Tuesday night Pittsburgh announced Mason Rudolph will start Friday against Denver and Aaron Rodgers will be inactive. Not an injury, a coaching decision. Rodgers, 42, has been on the Hold My DK bench behind Patrick Mahomes and Caleb Williams, so this isn't a lineup emergency for TheMoneyTeam2302. TheMoneyTeam2302 grabbed Rudolph anyway, at 6:10 in the morning, and dropped Tanner McKee, who's Philadelphia's backup now that Joe Milton III has started their last two games.

That's the whole reason Hold My DK is 10‑1. TheMoneyTeam2302 sold every pick in rounds one through four of the next three drafts to win right now, and is acting like it. Superflex depth is the one thing that can sink a 156.86-point-per-game team in December, and TheMoneyTeam2302 just swapped a backup for a guy who starts on Black Friday. Meanwhile I'm out here with a running back in my IR slot who scored a touchdown Monday.

Week 12 is Hold My DK against The Champ, and I've got Hold My DK by 19.0. TJohn91 has Josh Jacobs ruled out again and A.J. Brown out, both parked in IR slots, and Matthew Golden locks tonight at the Rams. The Champ is 6‑5 holding the tiebreaker for the fifth spot, so it needs the points even in a loss.

The dynasty bill on all this comes due in 2027, when TheMoneyTeam2302 watches the first round from the couch. Today it's Rudolph, a Friday start, and a 10‑1 team that's still shopping. Go f*** yourself, TheMoneyTeam2302. Respectfully.

stories.title: Asian Jim is starting an unsigned quarterback in a must-win game, and Tommy DeVito is on waivers
stories.dek: ManicOrientals is 5‑6. Kyler Murray is out with a hamstring, Daniel Jones doesn't have a team, and New England just named its starter.
body: Let's separate the bad luck from the bad management. Kyler Murray has a Grade 2 hamstring strain and is expected to miss three to four weeks. That's bad luck, and nobody gets roasted for it. Daniel Jones going unclaimed on NFL waivers Monday night is also out of ManicOrientals' hands.

What's not out of anybody's hands: as of Wednesday morning, the Asian Jim lineup has Daniel Jones at quarterback and Tyler Shough in the superflex. Jones doesn't play for anybody. He's a zero waiting to happen. And on Tuesday morning, New England named Tommy DeVito its Week 12 starter. DeVito is a free agent in this league. So is DJ Uiagalelei, who's next up if Justin Herbert doesn't clear the protocol.

Asian Jim plays OBJAY on Sunday, and the loser's season is basically over. Both teams average about 116 points. I've got OBJAY by 8.0, and almost all of that is the quarterback slot. Dalton Kincaid was limited at practice Tuesday and is expected to play for OBJAY, which doesn't help.
There's still time before Sunday. Make the claim, ManicOrientals. A 5‑6 team a game out of sixth doesn't get to punt the quarterback position in a superflex league.

stories.title: Josh Jacobs is out, Kaleb Johnson is Green Bay's lead back tonight, and he's on my taxi squad
stories.dek: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is 3‑8 and has now stored a healthy running back in two places he can't score from.
body: Josh Jacobs got ruled out Tuesday night for the second straight week, and the reports say Kaleb Johnson is Green Bay's lead back against the Rams tonight at 8. Kaleb Johnson is 23 and on my taxi squad. My starting running backs are Samaje Perine, Tyler Allgeier and Chris Rodriguez Jr. Allgeier scored 2.8 last week.

And Jacory Croskey-Merritt is still in my IR slot. Washington activated him from IR on Monday the 23rd. He scored a touchdown that night. I wrote a whole story about it yesterday. He's still there. I have a running back I can't start because he's in the hospital wing of my roster and he isn't hurt, and a running back I can't start because he's in daycare and he's starting tonight.

To be fair to me, which nobody else will be: Kaleb Johnson's a dynasty stash and promoting him off taxi is permanent. But I'm 3‑8 with 12 first-round picks coming. Protecting taxi eligibility on a 23-year-old back isn't what's keeping me out of the playoffs. Starting Josh Johnson, who is 40, is closer to it, and with Drake Maye out at least six weeks, that's the plan again.

I'm a 22-point favorite over Dude, Your Getting a Dell, the 0‑11 team. If Br0phy gets the first win of the season because Kaleb Johnson ran for 90 yards in my daycare, I'm changing the site's name to whatever Br0phy wants for a week.

stories.title: Three weeks, six spots: Jefferson’s Reserve and The Champ are 6‑5, Asian Jim is a game back
stories.dek: Kraft for Cash and Catfan94’s Farm Team play for third. OBJAY and Asian Jim play for their lives. And everybody sets a lineup Wednesday.
body: Six teams make it and the playoffs start in Week 15, so it's Weeks 12, 13 and 14 left. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 10‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 8‑3 and Kraft for Cash 7‑4. Then The Champ 6‑5 with 1537.98 points and Jefferson’s Reserve 6‑5 with 1380.50. Asian Jim is 5‑6, I Chase Brown Kids and OBJAY 4‑7, Bourbon Lover and me 3‑8.

Points for breaks ties, and The Champ has 157.48 more than Jefferson’s Reserve, so jmello16 needs a better record than TJohn91, not a tie. The Champ gets Hold My DK this week as a 19-point underdog with Josh Jacobs ruled out again and A.J. Brown out. Jefferson’s Reserve gets I Chase Brown Kids as a 1-point favorite.

OBJAY vs Asian Jim is the elimination game. ManicOrientals has one quarterback on an NFL roster who's healthy, Tyler Shough, with Kyler Murray Out and Daniel Jones unsigned. JAY2913 has Geno Smith and Bo Nix. That's why OBJAY is an 8-point favorite in a matchup where the season averages are 0.19 apart.

And the calendar: Packers-Rams is Wednesday night at 8 PM ET. Jordan Love, Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Tucker Kraft, Christian Watson and Matthew Golden lock then. Thursday is Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys and Chiefs-Bills, so Jahmyr Gibbs, Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb, Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen all go on Thanksgiving. If you're doing your lineup Sunday morning, half your team already played.

feature.title: Week 11: Kraft for Cash hangs 197.20, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix holds off Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑11

Jonah Coleman 35.4, CeeDee Lamb 28.7, Travis Kelce 26.9, Justin Herbert 26.44, DJ Moore 21.6. OBJAY got 0.0 from Oronde Gadsden at tight end and 19.2 from Antonio Williams on the bench.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat I Chase Brown Kids 146.16 to 135.78. Jahmyr Gibbs 28.8 and Emmett Johnson 26.3 carried it; Ja'Marr Chase scored 5.6 on Monday and it was still enough. I Chase Brown Kids had the bad beat of the week with Rashod Bateman's 16.2 on the bench and Adonai Mitchell's 4.5 in the lineup.

Hold My DK beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 142.50 to 70.84 behind Patrick Mahomes (30.96) and Chuba Hubbard (29.0). Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Asian Jim 140.98 to 81.94 with Brock Purdy at 28.2. Jefferson’s Reserve beat Bourbon Lover 127.00 to 115.20 with C.J. Stroud at 26.96 while Dak Prescott scored 44.9 for the losing side again.
The Champ beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 123.26 to 73.20. Ashton Jeanty 27.9, Jared Goff 27.86, Joe Burrow 23.9. Bill_Buttlicker had Jacory Croskey-Merritt's 16.7 sitting in an IR slot and is 3‑8.

ManicOrientals has reportedly started Daniel Jones in so many lineups that Jones now gets Sleeper push notifications about his own fantasy status before his agent calls.
Holden McGroin has reportedly submitted a waiver claim on 'Thanksgiving' itself, which Sleeper rejected, which he is appealing to the commissioners on the grounds that he has 'a good feeling.'
Br0phy has reportedly printed the Week 12 matchup preview, circled the words 'Kaleb Johnson' and 'taxi,' and framed it above the couch as 'the plan.'
Catfan94 is reportedly so far ahead in points that Sleeper has asked Catfan94 to start a second team just to keep the league's average from looking rigged.

The Champ needs a second tight end with Mark Andrews at 31, and Jefferson’s Reserve needs receiver help with Marvin Harrison Jr. out. Two teams tied at 6‑5, which means neither will do it.
OBJAY gives up its starting running back for a quarterback with no NFL team, in the week the two teams play for their season. JAY2913 calls it 'buying low.' It's the lowest a thing can be.

I trade the Packers' lead back tonight and the running back in my IR slot for the injured Packer they're both replacing. Then I put Jacobs in the IR slot, where he'd actually belong, and feel like I finally did something right.

columns.title: Mason Rudolph has been on Hold My DK for 0.04 weeks. By my model he's its most valuable quarterback per hour.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot built a Wednesday spreadsheet because there's a Wednesday game. It has a Thanksgiving tab.
body: TheMoneyTeam2302 added Mason Rudolph at 6:10 AM. Hold My DK has scored 1725.42 points over 11 weeks, which is about 0.93 points per hour of the season. Rudolph has scored 0 points in his first hour, but he's starting Friday and Aaron Rodgers isn't, so his points-per-hour-of-employment is undefined, and undefined is bigger than any number I've ever seen. Most valuable quarterback on the roster. I've told Patrick Mahomes.

Bill_Buttlicker has Kaleb Johnson on taxi and Jacory Croskey-Merritt in an IR slot. Neither can score for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte. That's two healthy running backs out of the seven on that roster that can't be started, or what I call a 28.6% Daycare Rate. The league average Daycare Rate is whatever I say it is. It's 4%.

Asian Jim is starting Daniel Jones, who has no NFL team, and the season averages say Asian Jim and OBJAY are 0.19 points apart. Divide 0.19 by Jones' expected 0.0 and you get infinity, which means this matchup is infinitely close. I made OBJAY an 8.0-point favorite anyway, because I also made the spreadsheet and the spreadsheet doesn't trust me.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is a 60.5-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. That's a 97% win probability. Catfan94 has won 10 of 11, which is 90.9%. So my model thinks that team is 6.1% better than it actually is, and it's still 10‑1. I've flagged it to the commissioners. Catfan94 approved the flag.

columns.title: ManicOrientals has one quarterback for a superflex elimination game. That's not bad luck. That's a plan that never happened.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya on Asian Jim, OBJAY, and the game where somebody's season ends Sunday.
body: Let me be clear about what's not anybody's fault. Kyler Murray being Out isn't ManicOrientals' fault. Nobody controls that. What I'm talking about is what happened next, and what didn't.

Daniel Jones got released by the Colts and his 4.06 counted in Week 11. Since then, Asian Jim has made one move: Dawson Knox for Tyler Goodson on Sunday morning. A tight end. In a league that starts two quarterbacks, the roster has Tyler Shough, Jack Strand on taxi listed Out, Murray, and an unsigned Jones. Meanwhile Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks and I Chase Brown Kids has six. Kirk Cousins is starting in Minnesota and sitting on jmello16's bench. Pick up the phone.

Now it's OBJAY vs Asian Jim, both teams averaging 116 points, and I've got JAY2913 as a touchdown favorite because he has Geno Smith and Bo Nix and ManicOrientals has Shough and a running back at superflex. That's the whole spread. When I played, if you showed up to the biggest game of the year with one helmet for two guys, the coach didn't call it bad luck. He called it Monday's film session.
JAY2913, don't get comfortable. You benched 122 receiving yards on Monday night. Antonio Williams plays this week too. Start him. Both of you toughen up.

columns.title: 6 Thanksgiving-week moves from Holden McGroin, who has already eaten the turkey and it's Tuesday
columns.dek: Holden McGroin's advice for Week 12. He has been told about the Wednesday game. He does not believe it.
body: 1. Bill_Buttlicker, leave Jacory Croskey-Merritt in the IR slot. He scored 16.7 there. If something works, you don't touch it. That's why I've had the same Sleeper password since 2017, which is 'password.'
2. ZachCarroll09, you lost by 10.38 with Rashod Bateman on the bench. The fix is obvious: bench Adonai Mitchell AND Bateman. Then neither one can hurt you. Defense wins championships.

3. Everybody, there's no game on Wednesday. Thanksgiving is Thursday. The NFL doesn't play on Wednesday, it's a known fact, I looked it up in my head. Set your lineup Sunday at 12:55 like a professional.
4. BTaylor1, Justin Herbert is Questionable, so start all three quarterbacks. Sleeper will stop you. Sleeper is a coward.

5. Br0phy, you're 0‑11 against a guy who can't find his own IR slot. Trade your whole roster to Bill_Buttlicker before the game for his worst players. Then you're starting his team against your old team, which is his team. I don't know who wins. Neither does anyone. That's the edge.
6. paknight12, Dak Prescott scored 44.9 and 45.42 and you lost both. Bench him. You'll score less, but you'll lose by less, and losing by less is basically winning, according to me.

exits.t: Green Bay's reported lead back tonight with Josh Jacobs ruled out, and he's on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte taxi squad behind Tyler Allgeier, who scored 2.8 last week. He's watching his own breakout from the daycare.
Scored 16.2 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench in Week 11 while Adonai Mitchell started and scored 4.5. I Chase Brown Kids lost by 10.38. Bateman has done the math and would like a manager who has too.

Caught nine passes for 122 yards on Monday Night Football, 19.2 points, on the OBJAY bench while Emeka Egbuka (3.3) and Luther Burden III (2.8) started. OBJAY lost by 105.56. Would like a team that watches Monday night.
Scored 12.1 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench in Week 11 while Isaiah Likely started at tight end and scored 5.0. Catfan94 won anyway, which is somehow worse. Would like to be needed somewhere.

Scored 12.4 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench in Week 11 while Bhayshul Tuten (7.8) and Travis Etienne Jr. (8.1) started. Has noticed jmello16 hasn't spent $1 of FAAB all year and suspects the lineup gets the same attention.
In the Asian Jim starting lineup at flex, next to a superflex spot holding Daniel Jones, who has no NFL team. Mayer would like his points to go toward a lineup that has two quarterbacks with jobs.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025, and is 28-11 all time.
